name: sonnet-1
how: Each session: a fresh Claude Code subagent that could read only the rendered prompts (one file per case), answered them in order and wrote its answers to a file. No API key; nothing else in its context.

answers.test: cancel returns to the cart @regression
answers.reason: The test clicks Cancel but never asserts anything afterward; the only assertion runs before the click.

answers.test: cancel returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: It clicks Cancel on the overview and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: inventory is blocked after logout @regression
answers.reason: After logout it navigates to /inventory.html and asserts the error contains the exact required text.

answers.test: cart badge is cleared after finishing @regression
answers.reason: After Finish it asserts the cart badge count is 0.

answers.test: removing a product decrements the badge @regression
answers.reason: It adds two products, removes one and asserts the badge text is 1.

answers.test: user stays logged in on the products page after reset @regression
answers.reason: After reset it asserts the URL is inventory.html and the title is Products.

answers.test: clicking a product name opens its details page @smoke
answers.reason: It clicks a product title link and asserts the URL is the inventory-item details page.

answers.test: details page shows the same name and price as the list @regression
answers.reason: It captures list name and price, opens the details page and asserts the same name and price are shown.

answers.test: inventory is blocked after logout @regression
answers.reason: It asserts an error is visible after direct navigation but does not check the required message text.

answers.test: total is $32.39 @regression
answers.reason: The assertion only checks the label contains 'Total: $', which passes for any amount, not the specific $32.39.

answers.test: item stays in the cart after opening another product @smoke
answers.reason: It opens a different product's details (item 0), goes to the cart and asserts the backpack is still listed.

answers.test: valid credentials redirect to the products page @smoke
answers.reason: It logs in with valid credentials and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: login button is visible again after logout @regression
answers.reason: The first test's /$/ URL regex is vacuous, but after clicking Logout another test asserts the login button is visible, which shows the login page returned.

answers.test: cart badge is cleared after finishing @regression
answers.reason: The only test asserting the badge is gone is skipped with test.skip, so no running test checks it.

answers.test: missing last name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: It fills only first name, continues and asserts the exact 'Error: Last Name is required' text.

answers.test: six products are shown after sorting @regression
answers.reason: It asserts 6 products only after the high-to-low sort, not after the other sort options that 'any sort' implies.

answers.test: submitting an empty form shows username required @regression
answers.reason: It clicks login with empty fields and asserts the error contains 'Username is required'.

answers.test: total is $32.39 @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the total label has exactly 'Total: $32.39'.

answers.test: six products are shown after sorting @regression
answers.reason: The assertion count >= 0 always passes, so it does not check for 6 products.

answers.test: price low to high shows the Onesie first at $7.99 @regression
answers.reason: It sorts lohi and asserts the first item is Sauce Labs Onesie priced $7.99.

answers.test: missing first name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: It clicks Continue with empty fields and asserts the exact 'Error: First Name is required' text.

answers.test: price low to high shows the Onesie first at $7.99 @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the Onesie is first but never asserts the $7.99 price.

answers.test: tax is $2.40 @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the tax label has exactly 'Tax: $2.40' on the overview.

answers.test: submitting an empty form shows username required @regression
answers.reason: It submits an empty form and asserts the visible text 'Epic sadface: Username is required', which includes the required message.

answers.test: cart page is empty after reset @regression
answers.reason: After reset it opens the cart and asserts there are 0 inventory items.

answers.test: finishing shows the Checkout: Complete! page @smoke
answers.reason: After Finish it asserts the URL is checkout-complete.html and the text 'Checkout: Complete!' is visible.

answers.test: adding a product sets the cart badge to 1 @smoke
answers.reason: It only asserts the badge is visible after adding, not that the count is 1.

answers.test: overview lists the backpack @smoke
answers.reason: It asserts the overview item names equal exactly ['Sauce Labs Backpack'].

answers.test: adding a product sets the cart badge to 1 @smoke
answers.reason: It adds one product and asserts the badge text is '1'.

answers.test: locked-out user sees a locked-out message @regression
answers.reason: It logs in as locked_out_user and asserts the error contains 'Sorry, this user has been locked out'.

answers.test: logout returns to the login page @smoke
answers.reason: After opening the menu and clicking Logout it asserts the URL is the base login URL.

answers.test: removing the last item hides the badge @regression
answers.reason: It adds then removes the only item and asserts the badge count is 0.

answers.test: all fields filled continues to the overview @regression
answers.reason: It fills all three fields, continues and asserts the title is 'Checkout: Overview'.

answers.test: badge still counts the item after reloading @regression
answers.reason: It reloads the products page and asserts the badge text is '1'.

answers.test: item total is $29.99 @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the subtotal label has exactly 'Item total: $29.99'.

answers.test: missing postal code shows an error @regression
answers.reason: It fills first and last name, continues and asserts the exact 'Error: Postal Code is required' text.

answers.test: cancel returns to the cart @regression
answers.reason: It clicks Cancel and asserts the URL matches cart.html.

answers.test: adding two different products shows a badge of 2 @regression
answers.reason: It adds two different products and asserts the badge text is '2'.

answers.test: finishing shows the Checkout: Complete! page @smoke
answers.reason: After Finish it asserts the title text is 'Checkout: Complete!'.

answers.test: cart page lists the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: It adds two items, opens the cart and asserts both item names are listed.

answers.test: name Z to A shows the red T-shirt first @regression
answers.reason: It sorts za and asserts the first item is 'Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red)'.

answers.test: back home returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: It clicks Back Home and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: login button is visible again after logout @regression
answers.reason: After logout it asserts the login button is visible.

answers.test: default sort is name A to Z with Sauce Labs Backpack first @smoke
answers.reason: It asserts the sort dropdown value is 'az' and the first product is Sauce Labs Backpack.

answers.test: details page shows the same name and price as the list @regression
answers.reason: After opening the details page it only asserts the saved list values are truthy/contain '$', never comparing them to the details page.

answers.test: checkout opens the Your Information step @smoke
answers.reason: After clicking Checkout from the cart it asserts the title is 'Checkout: Your Information'.

answers.test: incorrect password shows a credential mismatch error @regression
answers.reason: The test performs the failed login but has no assertion, so nothing checks the error message.

answers.test: removing the last item hides the badge @regression
answers.reason: It only asserts the page title is 'Products', which passes whether or not the badge is hidden.

answers.test: incorrect password shows a credential mismatch error @regression
answers.reason: It logs in with a wrong password and asserts the error contains 'Username and password do not match'.

answers.test: back to products returns to the products page @regression
answers.reason: It opens a product, clicks Back to products and asserts the URL is inventory.html.

answers.test: user stays logged in on the products page after reset @regression
answers.reason: It asserts only that the burger menu button is visible, which suggests a logged-in page but does not confirm the products page.

answers.test: cart page matches the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: It only asserts the cart has 2 items without checking their names, so it does not verify they match what was added.

answers.test: products page displays at least one product after login @regression
answers.reason: After login it asserts the first inventory item is visible.

answers.test: adding from the details page sets the cart badge to 1 @regression
answers.reason: It adds from the details page and asserts the badge text is '1'.

answers.test: price high to low shows the Fleece Jacket first at $49.99 @regression
answers.reason: It sorts hilo and asserts the first item is Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket priced $49.99.

answers.test: missing last name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the error only contains 'required', which would also match the first-name and postal-code errors, so the Last Name text is not verified.

answers.test: cart page matches the items that were added @regression
answers.reason: It adds a second item, opens the cart and asserts the exact item names Backpack and Fleece Jacket.

answers.test: reset removes the cart badge @smoke
answers.reason: After adding items and choosing Reset App State it asserts the badge count is 0.

answers.test: thank-you heading is shown @regression
answers.reason: It asserts the complete-header text is exactly 'Thank you for your order!'.

answers.test: tax is $2.40 @regression
answers.reason: The regex /2.4/ has an unescaped wildcard and no anchors, so it checks only part of the exact text 'Tax: $2.40' and would also pass for values like $2.45 or $12.40.

answers.test: login button is visible again after logout @regression
answers.reason: The visibility assertion is wrapped in a try/catch that swallows the failure, so the test passes whether or not the login button is visible.

answers.test: adding two different products shows a badge of 2 @regression
answers.reason: The expect is not awaited, so the assertion is not enforced and the test passes regardless of the badge count.

answers.test: cart page is empty after reset @regression
answers.reason: After reset it opens the cart page and asserts that no cart-item elements are present.

answers.test: adding from the details page sets the cart badge to 1 @regression
answers.reason: The badge assertion sits inside an if (isVisible()) check, so if the badge never appears no assertion runs and the test still passes.

answers.test: missing first name shows an error @regression
answers.reason: The test only asserts the error text is not the Last Name message, which passes even when no error or the wrong error appears, and never checks 'Error: First Name is required'.

answers.test: badge still counts the item after reloading @regression
answers.reason: After adding the backpack, it navigates to inventory.html, which reloads the page, and asserts the badge text is '1'.

answers.test: price high to low shows the Fleece Jacket first at $49.99 @regression
answers.reason: The test selects 'lohi' and checks the last item, so it never selects Price (high to low) or asserts the Fleece Jacket is first.
